base: Official Fedora Workstation 44 AArch64 Live ISO
session: GNOME Wayland; installed desktop entry selected at integration time

lcd.notes: LCD DTB includes local enable-gpios GPIO4/backlight changes requiring physical verification. Panel timing comes from DT/EDID; no fabricated monitors.xml.

graphics.notes: Fedora Mesa Freedreno/Turnip with GNOME Wayland. Vulkan and acceleration require physical verification.

evidence.zap_shader: DT firmware-name overrides generic upstream zap shader

wifi.notes: Calibration and MAC configuration belong to the owner device; association and throughput not physically verified.

bluetooth.notes: BlueZ enabled; public address fixup via udev. Pairing not physically verified.

touch_pen.notes: Device-triggered iptsd and input defaults. LCD size in centimetres; digitizer calibration/pen latency pending.

keyboard_touchpad.notes: All kernel modules retained; Fedora libinput defaults, no guessed pressure quirks.

audio.notes: Prefer upstream distro UCM; patch847 profile fallback with dispatcher when absent. No invented echo cancellation or beamforming. Speaker, microphones and USB-C audio need physical verification; DP PCM probing may require display connected before PipeWire starts.

sensors.notes: Driver and sensor-proxy presence does not prove sensors enumerate. Rotation, ambient light and mount matrix pending physical verification.

power_usb.notes: Keep Fedora UPower/logind/power profiles. Suspend, battery reporting, USB4/DP alt mode require physical verification.

dsp_npu.notes: Firmware and drivers shipped. No working userspace inference stack or NPU acceleration claimed; no world writable FastRPC rules.

camera.notes: Camera stack is not operational; media driver presence is insufficient. No fake libcamera tuning or privacy LED hooks installed.

video.notes: Exact firmware-name from compiled DTB. Codec device initialization and hardware decode need physical verification.

installed_boot.notes: Executable grub2-mkconfig generator selects the custom kernel/initrd/DTB using installed filesystem UUIDs and Btrfs subvolume flags. Anaconda installed-system boot needs physical validation; this is not an Anaconda transaction test. Normal default selects Surface; GRUB boot_once is honored. Kernel is pinned/copied outside RPM and future kernel updates require rebuilding the Surface artifacts. Installed DTB is independent at /boot/dtb-sp11/qcom/x1p64100-microsoft-denali.dtb, outside the stock kernel dtb symlink.
